component.name: Linux Client for AirPods Pro
component.summary: Heart-rate data from compatible AirPods Pro devices on Linux

description.p: An independent Linux client for heart-rate samples from AirPods Pro 3, with live history, session statistics, connection state, and recovery events.
The separate airpods-hubd daemon owns Bluetooth and shares readings with local applications. A deterministic demo works without AirPods.
Hardware testing covers AirPods Pro 3. Pair AirPods through Linux Bluetooth settings. Heart-rate output is experimental and is not for medical use.
